use_run now refuses --run X when the lock names another run, for every command; collect touches no pod but is refused, so a finished run's results cannot be packed or uploaded while another run holds the namespace (worked before f7beb833).

use_run's unretried kube_lock_get now runs in _heartbeat and _sampler before they write their pidfiles, inside start_daemon's 5 s window: a transient API error or a slow round trip makes up (after the lock) or ensure_daemons die.
typing_start writes this run's agent token into /work/typing/token unguarded when put_executable finds browsertype already in the runner, so it can overwrite another run's token file.
replay_prepare_run notes that the run stops when the copy is not ours, then goes on to nats_purge and scale_to; use || die as run_replay does.
runner_step_remove still has two forms behind a one-caller KEEP parameter.
The guard is pasted at 11 call sites in 5 shapes, and its three prose lists disagree with the code; put it in the runner/Postgres exec helpers and keep one list.
